# Datasets and data sources manifest (auto-generated, updated each cycle)

Total distinct data sources: 481 PDB structures + named datasets below = 493

## Named datasets

1. ProtDDG-Bench S2648 (training, PMID 21569468) - 2648 mutations
2. ProtDDG-Bench Ssym direct (342 rows)
3. ProtDDG-Bench Ssym inverse (342 rows, leak-free test)
4. ProtDDG-Bench P53 (42 experimental p53 ddG)
5. Pucci et al. 2018 Table 1 published benchmark values (transcribed from PDF)
6. ThermoMutDB human SOD1 subset (23 rows, 15 ddG)
7. FireProtDB 2.0 human SOD1 subset (9 dTm rows)
8. Known p53 Y220C suppressor set (Basu 2023 Table 4; Joerger/Fersht 2006)
9. SoDCoD SOD1 conformational database (188 mutants, metadata)
10. UniProt P00441 (SOD1 sequence/reference)
11. UniProt P04637 (p53 sequence/reference)
12. Zenodo record 8169289 (ThermoMPNN FireProtDB+PDB export)
